# Creatix — Full Reference

Creatix is a creative design agency based in Mumbai, India, working worldwide.
Founded 2016. 10+ years experience, 2,000+ companies served, 150M+ in tracked revenue.

## Services
- UI/UX Design — from Rs 49,999. User research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, usability testing.
- Web Development — from Rs 59,999. Static & CMS websites, e-commerce, performance-first builds, SEO-ready.
- 3D Designs — from Rs 39,999. Product visualisation, 3D brand illustrations, packaging renders.
- Motion Graphics — from Rs 29,999. Explainer videos, social reels, logo animation.

## Process
1. Free discovery call. 2. Fixed quote & timeline. 3. Weekly design reviews. 4. Launch + 30 days free support.
